title: Cajun Chicken and Rice

items.sub: 1 tsp smoked paprika + ½ tsp each garlic powder, oregano, cayenne, salt
Use 415ml chicken broth instead of cube + water

steps.x: Rinse basmati until water runs clear. Halve chicken breasts lengthwise, season both sides with about 2 tsp Cajun seasoning.
Stir Knorr cube into 415ml hot water.
Soften onion, then garlic, in oil. Deglaze with a splash of stock and scrape the bottom completely clean, or you'll get a Burn warning.
Stir in bell pepper, tomato paste and remaining Cajun seasoning. Pour stock over, lay chicken on top, spread rice evenly over everything. Do NOT stir.
Seal, valve to Sealing, High Pressure 7 min.
Natural release 5 min, then quick release. Shred chicken with two forks, stir everything together.
Finish with coriander and lime if you have them. Cool before portioning.

notes: Stock cube is saltier than broth; taste before adding salt.
Burn warning fix: deglaze fully, or skip sautéing, and never stir the rice in.
